# SnipZip

> SnipZip is a native macOS archive utility for creating ZIP archives, browsing archive contents, and extracting selected files. SnipZip is published by iRand OÜ.

Lang: en
Canonical: https://snipzip.app/

## Services

- [Create archives](https://snipzip.app/): Create ZIP archives for free. SnipZip Pro adds creation of additional archive formats and options.
- [Browse and extract archives](https://snipzip.app/formats.html): Open, browse, search, and extract more than 35 archive and compression formats, including ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, ISO, and CAB.
- [Search and selective extraction](https://snipzip.app/): Search archive filenames and paths, then extract selected files or folders. Search does not inspect file contents.
- [Finder integration](https://snipzip.app/faq.html): Use Finder actions and Quick Look to work with archives and folders.
- [Archive automation](https://snipzip.app/): Use Apple Shortcuts, SnipZip Pro's Workflow Builder, and SnipZip Pro command-line tools.

## What We Do Not Do

- SnipZip does not search inside the contents of files stored in an archive; search matches filenames and paths.
- SnipZip can open, browse, and extract RAR archives, but it does not create RAR archives.
- SnipZip processes archive files locally on the Mac; it is not an online archive-conversion service.
- SnipZip is a macOS app.
